candidates.change_summary: Delete the balance update `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);` so deposits are no longer recorded.
Swap the branches of the ternary so unlockTime is set to `_unlockTime` only when it is NOT in the future (min instead of max).
Delete the trailing `locked_ = false;` in the nonReentrant_ modifier so the lock is never released after Put completes, causing all subsequent guarded calls to revert.
Delete the `LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put");` call so deposits are no longer logged, changing observable state of the Log contract.
Remove the balance subtraction so a successful Collect never deducts from the caller's stored balance.
Remove the LogFile.AddMessage call so successful Collect operations are no longer recorded in the observable log history.
Send 0 wei instead of _am in the external call, so Collect transfers nothing while still logging and deducting _am.
Remove the reset of locked_ so the lock stays engaged after Collect/Put returns, causing all subsequent nonReentrant_ calls to revert.
